set.reason: Acute-angle complementarity is not in the side-length equation. It can usefully identify a right triangle when the angle is not given, supporting a restricted preparation link rather than the original hard claim. This acceptance is a new final mathematical judgment, not a mistaken activation from the prior native accept of Claude's rejection.
set.scope: Optionally identifying an unmarked right triangle from complementary acute angles
